caseNameFull: Andrus, Secretary of the Interior v. Shell Oil Co.

opinions.text: C. A. 10th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 822.] Motion of respondents to require the Solicitor General to file a brief conforming to the petition for cer-tiorari, or, in the alternative, to amend the order of the Court granting the petition, denied.
